name: claude-app-desktop
description: Electron desktop shell for claude-app: starts the gateway and web client, shows them in a window

scripts.pack: npm run prepare:release && npm run verify:release && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win --x64 --dir && npm run verify:package
scripts.dist: npm run prepare:release && npm run verify:release && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win nsis --x64 && node scripts/verify-package.mjs --installer
